email.subject: PO 3-90112 Moncton to Montreal Mon
email.body:
Hi, please pick up Monday Nov 23 8am sharp at Acadia Seafood Processors, 600 Mapleton Rd, Moncton NB E1G 3N9 and deliver to Marché Central Wholesale, 1100 rue Saint-Zotique E, Montréal QC H2S 1M3, Tuesday Nov 24 by 6am. 14 skids frozen lobster, 17,800 lbs, reefer -20C. Rate $1,950 CAD.

Thanks,
Marc-Antoine Léger
Acadia Seafood Processors
